record_type_quote:
Erlam & Ellis (2018) published, in Canadian Modern Language Review, an experimental
study that investigated the effect of input-based tasks on the acquisition of vocabulary and
markers of plurality by adolescent near-beginner learners of L2 French. The present paper
reports an approximate replication of the original study with the aim of confirming or
disconfirming the results.

targets.title: Task-based language teaching for beginner-level learners of L2 French: An exploratory study.

targets.outcome_quote:

targets.outcome_reasoning: The abstract explicitly gives an overall confirmation verdict for the replication as a whole. This takes precedence over a particular contrast concerning delayed grammar gains; productive vocabulary is an extension.
